run_significance_tests: run Wilcoxon signed-rank tests to compare docstring helpfulness scores between system pairs
run_cli_analyze_significance: run the CLI tool to analyze statistical significance of docstring helpfulness evaluation results
get_paired_scores: extract paired scores for two systems organized by aspect from evaluation results
get_system_scores: extract scores for a specific system organized by aspect from evaluation results
format_significance_markdown: format statistical significance test results into a markdown table for reporting
